profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Embedded Software engineer experienced in design, analysis, troubleshooting and enhancement of embedded software.

Specialties: Embedded Software / Device Driver Design, Troubleshooting and Analysis

--> Languages - C,C++, VHDL, Assembly
--> RTOS - WinCE, PSOS
--> Tools - Microsoft Visual Studio, SourceSafe, Platform Builder
--> Interface - USB, TCP/IP, Ethernet, I2C, RS-232

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Design, debug and support of embedded software, device drivers and embedded hardware for document imaging products.

positions.title: Electrical/Computer Engineer
positions.description: Design, debug and support of embedded software, device drivers and embedded hardware for document imaging products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and supported UNIX device drivers, running under the PSOS or VxWorks real time operating systems, to interface network management application to network routers and switches.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Design, debug and support of digital imaging hardware (discreet logic and PLDs) and DSP code (TI DSP).

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught several classes in electronic technology and electronic communications

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Design, debug and support of digital satellite communication hardware

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Design of test equipment used to verify classified, flight hardware used in anti-satellite and weather satellites
